title: filingPartyName
content: Name of the party filing the manifest (importer/exporter).

content: MPCI ID of the filing party.

title: filingPartyType
content: Type of filing party. Example: 'FF' for Freight Forwarder.

title: filingFor
content: Indicates if filing is for self or others. Example: 'SELF'.

title: blDate
content: Bill of Lading date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2026-02-25T00:00:00Z).

title: mblDate
content: Master Bill of Lading date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

title: issuingPartyName
content: Name of the party issuing the BL. Can be null.

content: MPCI ID of the issuing party. Can be null.

content: Name of the party issuing the MBL.

content: MPCI ID of the MBL issuing party.

title: processingInformation
content: Processing information code. Example: 'NEG' for negotiable.

content: Indicates if BL is split. 0 = no, 1 = yes.

content: Original BL number if split. Can be null.

title: consolePartyMpciId
content: MPCI ID of the consolidating party.

content: Update reason description. Can be empty.

content: Switch BL number. Can be null.
